dedupe_keys.name: mc cba toolkit model and case study

description: Pilo, Frabricio and colleagues document this resource through an ISGAN report deposited in Zenodo. The source defines an original software toolkit that implements a combined multicriteria and cost-benefit mathematical model. It automatically compares grid-investment alternatives with the Analytic Hierarchy Process across economic impacts, contribution to grid smartness and externalities. The source presents the active-distribution and storage-upgrade appraisal as an illustration of the reusable toolkit; that application already has a separate case-study record. This platform record represents the implemented software role for investment planning and optimization. Stakeholder preferences and selected criteria remain inputs to the appraisal, so an absence of personal bias is a source aspiration, not an independently established property. The deposit contains only the report PDF; executable access, code availability, interface and component licence are unknown. The report is openly available under CC-BY-4.0; these terms do not establish a software licence or public source-code release. Full descriptive metadata and file inventories were inspected. The PDF and any code or data bodies were not opened, and the calculations were not reproduced.
